rule: One listed phase per separate tool call, only after predecessor actual exit0, exact pass marker and independently checked receipt/identities. Keep exact returned command/output/exit and timing. Do not run this metadata file.

commands.command_body:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$phaseWatch = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$maximumMs = 30000
$evidenceReserveMs = 500
$runner = New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process
$runner.StartInfo = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
$runner.StartInfo.FileName = 'C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe'
$runner.StartInfo.Arguments = '-NoProfile -File "E:\projects\ladybug\repro\feat010-menu-clock-repair-20261018\controller-integration-20261019\run-recovery-preflight.ps1"'
$runner.StartInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
$runner.StartInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
$runner.StartInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $false
$runner.StartInfo.RedirectStandardError = $false
$started = $false
$exitConfirmed = $false
$nativeExitCode = $null
$runnerPid = $null
$runnerStartTicks = $null
$failure = $null
try {
    if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $runner.StartInfo.FileName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -cne '60c9b29843624dd8af6b6a7b26147753be6aeef65098b9a503cc50850afe410f') { throw 'Pinned native PowerShell image mismatch' }
    $started = $runner.Start()
    if (-not $started) { throw 'Native runner did not start' }
    $runnerPid = $runner.Id
    $runnerStartTicks = $runner.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks
    $remainingMs = [int][Math]::Floor($maximumMs - $evidenceReserveMs - $phaseWatch.ElapsedMilliseconds)
    if ($remainingMs -le 0) { throw 'No positive native wait budget remains' }
    $exitConfirmed = $runner.WaitForExit($remainingMs)
    if (-not $exitConfirmed) { throw 'Native runner exit unconfirmed at evidence reserve' }
    $nativeExitCode = $runner.ExitCode
    if ($nativeExitCode -isnot [int] -or $nativeExitCode -ne 0) { throw 'Native runner exit was not integer zero' }
} catch {
    $failure = $_.Exception.Message
}
$observed = [ordered]@{phase = 'P'; native_started = $started; pid = $runnerPid; start_ticks_utc = $runnerStartTicks; direct_exit_confirmed = $exitConfirmed; native_exit_code = $nativeExitCode; native_runner_start_to_observed_exit_ms = $phaseWatch.ElapsedMilliseconds; maximum_ms = $maximumMs; evidence_reserve_ms = $evidenceReserveMs; failure = $failure; unresolved_child = ($started -and -not $exitConfirmed); kill_attempted = $false}
[Console]::Error.WriteLine('PARENT_NATIVE_EXIT ' + (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $observed -Compress))
if ($null -ne $failure -or -not $exitConfirmed -or $phaseWatch.ElapsedMilliseconds -ge $maximumMs) { exit 1 }
exit 0

tool_api: One exact frozen command_body per tools.exec_command with all exec_command_fixed_arguments explicitly supplied, including pinned absolute shell and login:false. Retain every initial/poll result including session_id/exit_code/wall_time_seconds/output/truncation metadata. If session returned, no-write tools.write_stdin polls with explicit yield_time_ms5000 and max_output_tokens12000. Never start a poll if it can exceed the remaining whole-phase observation budget. No fresh budget on poll/model gaps. At cutoff stop observing, retain unresolved session/child identity/latest output, FAIL/BLOCK successors and retries; do not claim termination or cleanup. An unresolved child may hold inherited pipe handles, so wrapper completion is not guaranteed. Any missing/truncated required output fails admission.
parent_acceptance: Require actual native direct integer exit0 from bounded independent .NET monitor, actual tool wrapper exit0, exact expected phase marker plus matching receipt, complete fixture/control coverage, and total whole phase within maximum. Native monitor Stopwatch covers setup, native runner source/evidence/cleanup and actual observed child exit; 500ms reserved for bounded parent report. Wrapper actual exit and elapsed cap must independently agree. Receipt/marker/wrapper exit alone never passes. A transport session still live at cutoff or ambiguous elapsed evidence is FAIL/BLOCK, never a retry.
